keyEvents.text: Goal! Real Betis 0, Barcelona 1. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Jules Koundé.
Fermín López (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Héctor Bellerín (Real Betis) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Real Betis 1, Barcelona 1. Valentín Gómez (Real Betis) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Pablo Fornals with a cross following a corner.
Goal! Real Betis 1, Barcelona 2. Rodri (Barcelona) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Fermín López with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Barcelona. Eric García replaces Gerard Martín.
Substitution, Real Betis. Nelson Deossa replaces Dani Ceballos.
Goal! Real Betis 1, Barcelona 3. Gabriel Jesus (Barcelona) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Lamine Yamal.
Facundo Bernal (Real Betis) is shown the yellow card.

Goal! Real Betis 2, Barcelona 3. Abde Ezzalzouli (Real Betis) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Giovani Lo Celso with a through ball following a fast break.
Facundo Bernal (Real Betis) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card.
Diego Llorente (Real Betis) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Barcelona. Dani Olmo replaces Fermín López.
Substitution, Barcelona. Anthony Gordon replaces Karim Adeyemi.
Goal! Real Betis 2, Barcelona 4. Eric García (Barcelona) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Pau Cubarsí with a headed pass following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Real Betis. Troy Parrott replaces Cucho Hernández.
Substitution, Real Betis. Rodrigo Riquelme replaces Giovani Lo Celso.
Substitution, Barcelona. Raphinha replaces Lamine Yamal.
Substitution, Real Betis. Ángel Ortiz replaces Héctor Bellerín.
Substitution, Real Betis. Álvaro Fidalgo replaces Pablo Fornals.
Substitution, Barcelona. Gavi replaces Gabriel Jesus because of an injury.
Goal! Real Betis 2, Barcelona 5. Dani Olmo (Barcelona) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Pau Cubarsí.
Second Half ends, Real Betis 2, Barcelona 5.
